correctness.rationale: All three alternating join cycles exist for every k and are closed. Two maximal independent-face cocycles pair with the first two cycles by a determinant-one matrix. The known integral homology rank is two, proving they form an integral basis. Signed join permutations give both exact matrices; a symbolic determinant/Smith calculation gives cyclic and full-dihedral coinvariant groups. The packaged standard-library verifier checks signed chain identities through k=7 and reduced Betti numbers over three primes through k=5. Finite checks supplement, rather than prove, the all-k formula.

value.rationale: Integral symmetry of the standard cycle independence complex is intrinsically motivated by the classical sphere-wedge decomposition and the known rational dihedral character. The explicit infinite-family lattice distinguishes reflection sign choices invisible rationally, and the exact order-three coinvariant congruence mod four provides a concrete integral obstruction. The result is not merely a Betti-number recomputation or an arbitrarily chosen finite example.
